name: OCNCASH
recent: OCNCASH 于2026年9月完成以1342万令吉现金收购 Paragon Car Carpets & Components 全部股权，后者成为其全资子公司。近期董事及大股东有多笔股权变动，包括执行主席 Tan Siew Chin 在闭市期转让700万股给两名董事。公司尚未公布最新季度业绩。
notable: 公司以1342万令吉现金完成收购 Paragon Car Carpets & Components 全部股权，后者成为全资子公司。
执行主席 Tan Siew Chin 在闭市期转让700万股给董事 Tan Wey Chien 和 Tan Wey Chung。
执行董事兼集团首席执行官 Tan Wey Chien 在闭市期以零代价收购500万股。
risks: 董事及大股东在闭市期及近期出现多笔股权转让和收购，导致股权结构变动。

recent_en: OCNCASH completed the RM13.42 million cash acquisition of the entire equity interest in Paragon Car Carpets & Components in September 2026, making it a wholly-owned subsidiary. There were several recent changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests, including Executive Chairman Tan Siew Chin transferring 7 million shares to two directors during the closed period. The company has not yet announced its latest quarterly results.
notable_en: The company completed the acquisition of the entire equity interest in Paragon Car Carpets & Components for RM13.42 million cash, making it a wholly-owned subsidiary.
Executive Chairman Tan Siew Chin transferred 7 million shares to directors Tan Wey Chien and Tan Wey Chung during the closed period.
Executive Director and Group CEO Tan Wey Chien acquired 5 million shares at nil consideration during the closed period.
risks_en: There were multiple share transfers and acquisitions by directors and a substantial shareholder during the closed period and recently, resulting in changes to the shareholding structure.
